display_long_description:
[media]
# 🦙 Are you the hunter... or the prey?
Welcome to Alpaca Party, a chaos-filled social game packed with thrilling party modes, adorable alpacas, and endless betrayal.

# 🎡 Cozy Fun Lobby
Take a break from the madness. 
Ride the Ferris wheel, play Flying Chess, or bounce around in roly-poly tag. A perfect place to chill, meet friends, and customize your fluffy alpaca.
**Ready for more? Your fluffy alpaca pal can whisk you straight to all our other awesome game modes!**
[media]
# 🎭 Escape Mode
A folklore-inspired nightmare. 
Become an Overseer or an Investigator and enter a game of asymmetrical hide-and-seek. Use your unique skills and hidden tools to outwit the other side before time runs out.
[media]
# 🐺 Party Kill Mode
Trust no one. 
By day, complete tasks and uncover roles. By night, deceive and eliminate your enemies. Fast-paced minigames and unexpected twists keep every round fresh and fun.
[media]
# 🌙 Travel World!
Solo, serene, and satisfying. 
Explore beautiful maps, collect coins, and master parkour puzzles at your own pace.
[media]
# 💬 Join Our Community
Meet other players, share your ideas, and stay updated in our 
# Discord: 
# discord.gg/fXzg8gwrpr
[media]
